record.body:
## Description

R30: The Playwright test opens a phase page through the real server.

## Approach

Read the frozen test in `dashboard/frontend/e2e/app.spec.ts` (the case that starts with `R30`) first.

- Build the frontend and run the Playwright suite: `cd dashboard/frontend && npm run e2e -- --grep R30`. The test opens the effort page on the seeded store through the real server, clicks the phase row, and expects the phase page.
- The seed in `e2e/serve.py` already holds one effort, one phase and one task. Change it only if the test needs more.
- If the test fails on the real server, fix the cause in the code from the earlier tasks, not in the test.
- Close with `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`.
